svg.title: STFE 2027 Brand Guidelines — Brand introduction
svg.desc: STFE 2027 brand identity. Fonts: Rajdhani and Manrope (Google Fonts, SIL OFL) must be installed for correct text rendering. The STFE 2027 logo is the approved raster artwork embedded unaltered.

text.tspan: Illustrative imagery · not a photograph of a past STFE edition
STFE — Smart Trade Fair & Expo — is a three-day B2B and B2C exhibition
in Agra where entrepreneurs, startups, manufacturers and MSMEs
showcase their brands, meet the right people and learn about market
